Several broad clean rounded ribs on each component, flowing with structural purpose; no chaotic greebles or sharp edges.
Palette and material: preserve approved muted jade/verdigris, but use smooth satin nacre jade shell panels and lighter pearl-celadon ribs. Deep muted plum ONLY in narrow shadow seams and core recesses, no broad flesh. Subtle amber seam at boarding hatch and warm station rimlighting. Refined clean surfaces, faint natural grain, no cracked rock/scales. Organic grown elegance, inviting and functional.
